explanation: Vertical stack of heavy (m=20) + 4 light (m=0.2) bodies with e=1 acts as Newton's-cradle amplifier. Sequential elastic impulses between disparate masses plus iterative positional correction pump kinetic energy into light bodies (speeds ~25-32 m/s at step 561, e.g. body4 32.19 m/s), so total energy grows from 429.68J to 477.71J with zero controller work, exceeding allowed 477.65J.
